idiom.note: raw pinned threads + one bounded SPSC ring per (worker, worker) pair; the master (actor 0, thread 0) sends one range per worker actor w (id cores + w) on thread w % cores -- qb's placement; not an actor framework and not ranked as one

caveats: THIS IS NOT A FRAMEWORK. A work message is one ring message carrying the range, a result one ring message carrying the area's bits, and the integration is the same shared kernel every framework runs: the floor for a fan-out and fan-in of pure computation

worker w is owned by thread w % cores and the master by thread 0, fixed before the window -- qb's placement exactly: with cores=2 each thread integrates the ranges of the workers it owns, so this floor bounds the placing frameworks and NOT the pools
cores=1 is one thread with every actor's messages in its own ring -- the floor for single-threaded dispatch, still a real queue
wait=1 busy-polls the rings; wait=0 parks an idle worker on a condition variable
